verdict.rationale: Angular's docs claim fine-grained reactivity via Signals, which implies targeted DOM updates. Community users cite AOT compilation and strong rendering performance, roughly 2x faster than other frameworks when optimized. Nothing in the pack explicitly documents a compiler-generated rendering path that skips virtual DOM diffing. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the compiler/renderer architecture, explicit confirmation that there is no virtual DOM diffing step, and current hands-on corroboration (the community reports date from the Angular 2 era).
